title: ReviewTelemetryEvent
description: Append-only shadow-telemetry record for one Faraday Review run (Phase 1.11), including founder adjudication when recorded. Adjudication matching is on the founder's immutable account node_id, never on login; non-founder labels are rejected and logged as adjudication_rejected. No model cost fields exist in Phase 1 — there is no model. Secret values never appear in any field. From v0.4.0 a record MAY carry execution identity (event_id, execution); semantics are normative in review-telemetry-identity.md. v0.3.0 records carry no execution identity and consumers MUST NOT synthesize one.

fingerprint.description: Idempotency fingerprint: canonical digest over ordered inputs; contains no timestamp.

founder_classification.description: Written by a faraday/founder-<class> label applied by the founder account for this head SHA.

adjudicated_by.description: Immutable account node_id captured during discovery; login is informational only.

event_id.description: v0.4.0+. Producer-generated identifier of this emitted event: a lowercase RFC 9562 UUID, version 4 or 7, never derived from event content. Every archived copy of the event carries the same value; no two emissions share one. Same meaning as execution-event.event_id. Not a task, review or transport identifier.

provider.description: Platform that ran the reviewer. Closed set; a new provider is a contract change.

run_id.description: GitHub Actions github.run_id of the workflow run that emitted this event.

run_attempt.description: GitHub Actions github.run_attempt. A re-run of the same run_id is a distinct execution with a higher run_attempt. Unrelated to `retries` (in-execution API retries).

execution.description: v0.4.0+. The platform execution that emitted this event. Requires event_id. Execution identity is (provider, repository casefolded, run_id, run_attempt).
